recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce $closure for FHIR-13481; only revisit if Terminology Infrastructure separately decides to restore the operation in the current build.
issue_request: FHIR-13481 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocab change request for ConceptMap asking that the $closure input parameter `version` be typed as string instead of id because the examples and use cases treated version values as strings.
initial_application: The Jira issue says the change was applied in svn revision 13308. Git commit 4ce38f7d888beef54b46323abd585e6c0b481999 is the matching git-svn build@13308 import and changed `source/conceptmap/conceptmap-spreadsheet.xml` so `closure.version` used string instead of id; the 2021 source rework later carried that into `source/conceptmap/operationdefinition-ConceptMap-closure.xml` with `<type value="string"/>`.
additional_context: ConceptMap remains active in current build scope, but $closure is no longer a current ConceptMap operation. Commit 40306e5cd9c1b1e3eb6f115de16a8da3aa13a351 removed the $closure OperationDefinition and examples during R6 normative-ballot terminology cleanup, and the current ConceptMap operation list and terminology service/module pages list only ConceptMap $translate. Zulip and Confluence records match the Jira request and block-vote history and do not reveal a conflicting current requirement.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The requested datatype correction was applied while $closure existed, and the current specification has no $closure `version` parameter to correct.

related_jiras.note: Later ConceptMap relationship changes also discussed $closure return semantics, but not the FHIR-13481 version parameter type.
A later R5 closure-table wording issue was found in Jira search, but it is independent of the version datatype and $closure is absent from current source.
